name: @permitzip/bim-script
description: MutinyBIM scripting kit: defineScript with typed parameters in bim-units, a recorder over the kernel's intent commands, deterministic ids and seeded random, the reads slice, part-type output, 500-step batch_edits chunking, the kit's checks, the ScriptRunner contract with its conformance suite, and the mutinybim-script run | check | pack CLI. Scripts produce ordinary edits and ordinary part types; they never run in a model server. Must not import any host app's code.
